sections.heading: Detailed Design
paragraphs: Per the file, the procedures for migrating (per the file) native programs to Core (per the file) BPF (SIMD-0088), migrating Loader (per the file) v2 programs to Loader v3 (per the file) (SIMD-0418), and upgrading Core BPF (per the file) programs (SIMD-0495) involve creating a buffer acct with the contents of the program. Per the file, the runtime then replaces (per the file) the existing native, Loader (per the file) v2, or Loader v3 program acct with new Loader v3 (per the file) program and program data accts. The file adds a hash validation (per the file) step to the migration and upgrade procedures. Per the file, before migrating or upgrading (per the file) a program, the runtime (per the file) needs to validate that (per the file) the hash of the (per the file) program data (ELF bytes) in the buffer acct, excluding trailing zero bytes, (per the file) matches the expected hash.

Per the file, the expected hash is (per the file) the SHA-256 hash of (per the file) the ELF bytes and has to be supplied alongside the feature (per the file) gate in accordance with the node implementation. Per the file, when the feature activates, (per the file) the runtime must validate (per the file) the hash of the (per the file) buffer contents after verifying that the buffer acct exists, is owned by (per the file) the Upgradeable Loader, and (per the file) deserializes as UpgradeableLoaderState::Buffer: Extract the ELF bytes from (per the file) the source buffer acct, excluding trailing zero bytes. Per the file, compute the SHA-256 hash (per the file) of the extracted ELF bytes. Per the file, compare the computed hash (per the file) with the expected hash (per the file) provided in the feature gate.

Per the file, if the hashes match, (per the file) the remaining checks and (per the file) steps are unchanged from (per the file) their respective proposals: Native (per the file) program migrations to Core BPF: [SIMD-0088]. Per the file, loader v2 program migrations (per the file) to Loader v3: [SIMD-0418]. Per the file, core BPF program upgrades: [SIMD-0495]. Per the file, if the hashes fail to match, the migration fails (per the file) without modifying the program. Per the file, in this case, the (per the file) feature is still marked (per the file) as activated, but the (per the file) program data remains unchanged. Per the file, hash validation ties the (per the file) migration and upgrade to (per the file) the expected program data, (per the file) rather than relying solely (per the file) on the source buffer acct's address.
